issue.title: use gimbal plugin's gibal_list and attitude function, the gimbal_id is not match.
issue.body: use gimbal plugin's gibal_list and attitude function, the gimbal_id is not match. I try to control camera gimbal through mavsdk-server and mavsdk-python. the system only has one gimbal, gimbal_list return gimbal_id is 1, but somtimes I can not control this gimbal with gimbal_id:1. I get retsult from attitude the gimbal_id is 3, and I can control the gimbal with gimbal_id:3. this situation occurrs sometimes. mavsdk_server version: 3.6.0 mavsdk-python version: 3.6.0 PX4 version: 1.15.4

comments.body: What sort of gimbal is this and how is it connected and set up?
> What sort of gimbal is this and how is it connected and set up? gimbal sort: SIYI A8mini uart telem2 MNT_MODE_IN and OUT both with MAVlink gimbal protocol v2

Can you get the same logs with env variable `MAVSDK_GIMBAL_DEBUGGING=1`? I'm not quite sure what is going on.

Also, what SIYI gimbal version is this?

Thanks!

Can you get the full output of the gimbal list?

My guess is that there is one message sent by the gimbal device (SIYI) and one by PX4, but I'm not 100% sure.

I have this gimbal on my desk, so I will have to try to reproduce this tomorrow.

Didn't get to it today. Hopefully tomorrow.

Ok, I'm just trying to reproduce this. I'm using gimbal version 0.3.8 at the moment.

I can control the gimbal from the PX4 MAVLink shell, using e.g. `gimbal test pitch -45`.

The gimbal example fails with:


Message 283 is [GIMBAL_DEVICE_INFORMATION](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#GIMBAL_DEVICE_INFORMATION).

Usually I would have expected it to work even without GIMBAL_DEVICE_INFORMATION available, but here we are...

Let me try to upgrade to v0.3.9 next.

I updated the SIYI gimbal to v0.4.3, however, it still didn't send GIMBAL_DEVICE_INFORMATION.

Then I realized I had to enable forwarding for MAV_1_FORWARD which is connected to the gimbal.

I should probably make it so that the GIMBAL_DEVICE_INFORMATION is not required.
